geopolitica.title: Trump Gets Another Ally in EU With Jansa’s Return in Slovenia
geopolitica.summary: Slovenian lawmakers elected nationalist leader Janez Jansa as the country’s next premier, tilting another European Union member to the right and handing Donald Trump a potential ally in the bloc.

geopolitica.title: EU Warns Companies to Diversify Supply Lines From China Faster
geopolitica.summary: The European Union’s industry chief said that businesses on the continent haven’t done enough to reduce major dependencies on China.

geopolitica.title: UK Military Air Show Canceled Over Middle East War Uncertainty
geopolitica.summary: The Royal International Air Tattoo at RAF Fairford, the UK’s biggest military air show, has been canceled this summer because US aircraft are using the venue for missions related to the Iran war, which continues to have wide-ranging impacts.

economia_mercados.title: Turkish Assets Bounce Back After Court Blow to Opposition
economia_mercados.summary: Turkish assets rebounded after a rout yesterday as investors shrugged off the fallout from a court decision removing the leadership of the country’s main opposition party.

economia_mercados.title: The Hunt to Uncover a Global Art Trafficking Network
economia_mercados.summary: A global art conspiracy saw a nation's heritage ransacked. Decades later, investigators tracked down the perpetrators. Matthew Campbell discusses his book The Man Who Stole the Gods. (Source: Bloomberg)

economia_mercados.title: Oil Swings With Market Focused on US-Iran Peace Prospects
economia_mercados.summary: Oil fluctuated as traders assessed the outlook for a peace deal to end the war between the US and Iran.
